# cycle_containers (Data Source)

Lists Cycle containers in the hub, optionally filtered to a single environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List every container in the hub.
data "cycle_containers" "all" {}

# Or only those in a specific environment.
data "cycle_containers" "api" {
  environment_id = "651efd54c53f7b6e2c5a9f21"
}

output "container_names" {
  value = [for c in data.cycle_containers.all.containers : c.name]
}

output "running_container_ids" {
  value = [
    for c in data.cycle_containers.api.containers : c.id
    if c.state == "running"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `environment_id` (String) When set, only containers belonging to this environment ID are returned.

### Read-Only

- `containers` (Attributes List) The list of containers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--containers))

<a id="nestedatt--containers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `containers`

Read-Only:

- `config` (String) The container configuration as normalized JSON.
- `environment_id` (String) The ID of the environment this container is deployed into.
- `hub_id` (String) The ID of the hub this container belongs to.
- `id` (String) The unique ID of the container.
- `identifier` (String) The human-readable slugged identifier of the container.
- `image_id` (String) The ID of the image used to create this container.
- `instances` (Number) The number of instances for this container.
- `name` (String) The user-defined name of the container.
- `state` (String) The current state of the container.
- `stateful` (Boolean) Whether this container is stateful.
